content.comment_body: Hello, On the [product_name] CMR [version_no] unit, what kinds of information can be sent to specified phone numbers? For instance, can you transmit machine status (active/inactive), counter values, or data from an analog amplifier block? Or do you need to access [product_name] from your mobile device to view real-time information? Thank you
Yes, this functionality is available. Refer to the relevant manual: [document]: [company_name] NET: [product_name] - Industrial Ethernet, [product_name] CMR[version_no]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are investigating how the [product_name] CMR Mobile Communication module allows data to be sent directly to phone numbers. The main discovery is the need for clearer documentation on messaging capabilities, details of real-time access, and the type of notifications supported, with users being guided to consult manuals for details.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to transmit machine status updates and various data values to mobile devices, as well as potentially view real-time information remotely through their phones.
